title: Earths Magnetic Field
definition: Earth's magnetic field (geomagnetic field) is a dynamic dipolar shield extending from the Earth's interior out into space, where it interacts with the solar wind, protecting the biosphere from harmful cosmic and solar radiation.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in UPSC CSE Prelims through conceptual questions on magnetic poles vs. geographic poles, inclination, declination, and dynamo theory. In Mains (GS-1 Geography), it relates to Earth's internal structure, atmospheric evolution, and space weather dynamics.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Earths Magnetic Field.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Interior of the Earth (Crust, Mantle, Core)
